Class OfferSpacePayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.OfferSpacePayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OfferSpacePayload extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the state of a single space on the board's offer path.

Each space has details on how many cards can be taken from the top/bottom rows, and which player (by nickname) currently occupies the space with their totem.
